---
title: Поиск коровых генов без аутгруппы
engine: knitr
---

Поиск коровых генов без аутгруппы с помощью Roary (55 современных и 4 древних)


::: {.cell}

```{.bash .cell-code}
mkdir -p ../data/all_gff_no_outgroup_C_H
cp ../data/avaliable_gff_C_H/*.gff ../data/all_gff_no_outgroup_C_H/
cp ../data/new_gff_C_H/*.gff ../data/all_gff_no_outgroup_C_H/
cp ../data/BTC_consensus_gff_C_H/*.gff ../data/all_gff_no_outgroup_C_H/
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.bash .cell-code}
mkdir -p ../data/all_core_alignment_no_outgroup_C_H

source ../scripts/make_core_alignment_roary.sh
roary ../data/all_gff_no_outgroup_C_H ../data/all_core_alignment_no_outgroup_C_H
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.text .cell-code}
Core genes	(80% <= strains <= 100%)	451
Soft core genes	(79% <= strains < 80%)	85
Shell genes	(15% <= strains < 79%)	2782
Cloud genes	(0% <= strains < 15%)	9223
Total genes	(0% <= strains <= 100%)	12541
```
:::


Выделим из них snp


::: {.cell}

```{.bash .cell-code}
snp-sites -cb -o ../data/all_core_alignment_no_outgroup_C_H/80_percent/core_snps_no_outgroup_C_H.fa \
          ../data/all_core_alignment_no_outgroup_C_H/80_percent/core_gene_alignment.aln

snp-sites -o ../data/all_core_alignment_no_outgroup_C_H/80_percent/core_snps_no_outgroup_C_H.fa \
../data/all_core_alignment_no_outgroup_C_H/80_percent/core_gene_alignment.aln
```
:::
